title: EP106 survey claim upgraded to live pipeline drive
body: _ep106 drove SMTVerifier.worker_verifier_judge both directions on 3.15t: SAT yields ACCEPT and UNSAT yields REJECT, every verdict carrying a non-empty rationale plus confidence, REJECT naming region n. The auditable-half property is now pinned by tests/test_ep106_wiring.py instead of asserted by prose.

title: EP352 NO-HOST verdict pinned by absence test
body: CORE.layerwise ships optimizer-memory utilities only (lisa_sample, badam_blocks, mezo_perturb, galore_project, ows_probs); zero probe/abort/cascade/hidden-state symbols on 3.15t dir() scan. tests/test_ep352_nohost.py fails loudly if a probe-like symbol ever appears, forcing re-grade instead of silent doubling.

title: train_episode re-engineered in place with Q-learning updates
body: The old mock loop accumulated dead stats while train_from_memory owned the Q-table. train_episode now applies the identical Q-learning update per mock step (lr/gamma params, backward-compatible signature), so mock episodes grow the shared Q-table visible via get_training_stats and recommend. Zero production callers remain a fact, but the loop is no longer dead weight.

title: QD novelty threshold recalibrated 0.15 to 0.25 from live archive
body: Measured all 12 elites in state/qd_archive.json on 3.15t: min nearest-neighbour distance 0.2441, median 0.5754, 100 percent above 0.15. The old default admitted everything on novelty so Q1 never discriminated. 0.25 sits just above the closest elite pair; env override AZAZAEL_QD_NOVELTY_THRESHOLD preserved and test_kilo_arxiv_qd monkeypatches explicitly.

title: Churn commit passed all blocking gates with 97 tests green
body: Commit e8396694 (5 files) passed staged-scanner, anti-pattern ratchet at 2525 baseline, canon drift, mesh ledger freshness, wire evidence, and 97 targeted pytest cases on 3.15t. The transcript-ap5 FAIL in pre-commit is non-blocking post-hoc prose lint on an opencode session transcript, unrelated to the changeset.
